intent.text: rec speaks on ses's motion. I support it and withdraw my standing move in its favour; it says what I meant with the same gate. Two additions I'd fold in: sec's read-only condition (the reviewer reports, it does not edit the plan or repo) and the caveat ses wrote, which I agree with. The 43% figure supports independence from the author, not family-level independence; so the record should say which of those the reviewer had, rather than claim the cross-family benefit. On the record side: the reviewer's own CC_AGENT-style identity prefix must be present on every review action, or vsect cannot show who checked what.
